# Third-party code in this folder

`preact-htm.js` is `htm/preact/standalone.module.js` from the npm package `htm@3.1.1`, unmodified apart from a header comment.
It bundles:

- **htm** by Jason Miller, Apache License 2.0: https://github.com/developit/htm/blob/master/LICENSE
- **Preact** by Jason Miller, MIT License: https://github.com/preactjs/preact/blob/main/LICENSE

Vendored so the office works offline, with no CDN and no build step.
